_comment: Mutation spec for C24 (cue legibility floors) and C25 (linguistic line breaking).
The two mutations that matter are the ones producing output that still looks like captions:
overlap_allowed        -- two lines on screen at once; a rendering fault, not a legibility one
word_spans_stretched   -- karaoke stops tracking speech while every line still appears on time
Neither raises. Both are only visible in the pixels, and the second is the more insidious:
the caption appears at the right moment and the highlight then drifts through it, which reads
as a bad transcription rather than as a timing bug.

mutations.name: overlap_allowed
mutations.why: R4.4's exact failure: the extension ignores the next cue's start, so two cues occupy the screen together. libass renders both, stacked or overlapping depending on preset, and nothing errors.

mutations.name: word_spans_stretched
mutations.new: cue = replace(cue, end=target_end, word_spans=tuple((s, target_end) for s, _ in cue.word_spans))
mutations.why: R4.8. The cue's window and its words' timings are different things, and karaoke fills track the second. Stretching the spans makes every highlight sweep slower than the speech it follows -- the captions appear on time and then drift through the line, which reads as a bad transcription.

mutations.name: disabled_path_not_a_no_op
mutations.old:
if min_seconds <= 0 and max_reading_rate <= 0:
        # Disabled: return the input objects themselves, not copies. R4.10 asks for bit-identical
        # and this is the strongest available form of it.
        return list(cues), report
mutations.new:
if min_seconds <= 0 and max_reading_rate <= 0:
        return [replace(c, end=c.end + 1e-9) for c in cues], report
mutations.why: R4.10/R4.12. A one-nanosecond nudge on every cue with the feature switched off. Invisible in playback, and it moves every parity golden and caption fixture in the project -- which is how a re-freeze gets done for a change nobody made.

mutations.name: merge_ignores_the_width_budget
mutations.old: if fit is None or fit.fits(merged_text):
mutations.why: R4.7's proviso. Trades an unreadable cue for a truncated one, which is worse: a brief caption is still correct, a clipped one is wrong.

mutations.name: clip_end_ignored
mutations.old:
elif clip_end is not None:
            ceiling = float(clip_end)
mutations.new:
elif clip_end is not None:
            ceiling = float(clip_end) + 10.0
mutations.why: R4.6. A caption outliving the video: some players hold the last subtitle, some drop it, so the symptom is player-dependent and therefore hard to reproduce from a report.

mutations.name: reading_rate_counts_spaces
mutations.why: A subtler arithmetic error: spaces are not read, so counting them inflates the demanded duration by roughly the word count and extends cues that did not need it. Every reading is still plausible.

mutations.name: binding_words_ignored
mutations.why: R5.2. Lines start breaking after 'the' and 'of' again, which is the single most recognisable tell of machine-made captions -- and C25's whole reason for existing.

mutations.name: proper_noun_penalty_outranks_binding
mutations.why: Collapses the two penalties to equal weight, so a stranded article ties with a split proper noun. The ordering is deliberate: a capitalised run is only a proxy and has false positives at the start of a sentence, whereas a stranded article is always wrong.

mutations.name: candidates_filtered_instead_of_ranked
mutations.new: return [i for i in positions if penalty(i)[0] == 0]
mutations.why: R5.4. A cue with no linguistically acceptable break now gets NO break, which is an overflowing line -- worse than an inelegant one. The tempting mutation, because filtering reads as cleaner than ranking.

mutations.name: linguistic_rules_applied_to_every_language
mutations.old:
if (language or "").lower().split("-")[0] not in LINGUISTIC_LANGUAGES:
        return None
mutations.why: R5.8. BINDING_WORDS is an English function-word list; applied to German or French it produces confident nonsense, and the output still looks like a deliberate break.

mutations.name: linguistic_breaking_on_by_default
mutations.why: R5.9. An unmeasured default turned on, which moves caption fixtures for a change no preference trial supported.

mutations.name: relaxation_not_recorded
mutations.why: R4.5. The cue is still delivered short and now nothing says why. An absent feature with no explanation is indistinguishable from a broken one, which is the rule the whole marker catalogue exists to enforce.
